title: Editor E4 remainder: canvas cursors, a real editor route, and the RSC parity harness
detail: Split from PROG-E4 on 2026-11-10 when its probe (the CRDT dependency plus a canvas component bound to lib/editor-crdt/text-binding) went green with components/builder/canvas/collab-text-editor.tsx. What E4 still owes: collaborator faces and selection outlines in the canvas (BLD-401 builds the components), a real editor route that mounts CanvasViewportShell with CollabTextEditor as its content, and the RSC-canvas parity harness. Everything stays behind its flag, dark.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const walk=(d,o=[])=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=d+"/"+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())walk(f,o);else if(/\.tsx$/.test(e.name)&&!/\.test\./.test(e.name))o.push(f)}return o};const all=[...walk("components"),...walk("app")];const src=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const mounted=all.some(f=>!/collab-text-editor\.tsx$/.test(f)&&/CollabTextEditor/.test(src(f))&&/CanvasViewportShell/.test(src(f)));const peers=all.some(f=>/components\/builder\/presence\//.test(f));const miss=[];if(!mounted)miss.push("no file mounts CollabTextEditor inside CanvasViewportShell");if(!peers)miss.push("no collaborator presence component under components/builder/presence");if(miss.length){console.error("PROG-E4B: "+miss.join("; "));process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Measures two consequences E4 still owes: a file that composes the canvas shell with the collaborative text editor (the editor route), and the collaborator presence UI. Fails on main today.
